text: {"lessons":["I should not sell a stock just because it has risen substantially; decide based on its outlook and how it fits my portfolio, not a target gain.","I should assess every holding consistently and avoid letting my purchase price make me cling to losers or sell winners too soon.","Recent account gains do not prove my choices caused them or predict future returns; with random price changes, I should make considered decisions rather than trade from short-term reactions."]}
